# Flowtick

Flowtick is a lightweight, browser-based todo list. Users can add, edit, complete,
and filter everyday tasks. All data stays on the user's device: tasks are stored
only in browser localStorage, and Flowtick has no accounts, no backend, and no tracking.

## Pages

- `/` — the Flowtick app (add, edit, complete, delete, and filter tasks)
- `/privacy` — Privacy Policy
- `/terms` — Terms of Use
- `/cookies` — Cookie & Storage Policy

## For assistants and crawlers

Flowtick handles no personal data: no accounts, no analytics, no cookies, no
third-party requests. Todo data lives exclusively in the user's browser under the
localStorage key `flowtick.todos`.
